National & World News

Oct. 21, 2013: Shooting at Nevada middle school

A parent escorts his child from Agnes Risley Elementary school following a shooting at nearby Sparks Middle School on Oct. 21, 2013 in Sparks, Nev. A staff member was killed and two students were injured after a student opened fire at the Nevada middle school. The suspected gunman was also killed. Students from the middle school were evacuated and held for parents at the elementary school.

resultats_lens.texte_contexte: Un parent raccompagne son enfant depuis l'école élémentaire Agnes Risley à la suite d'une fusillade survenue à proximité, à l'école intermédiaire Sparks (Sparks Middle School) à Sparks, au Nevada, le 21 octobre 2013. Un membre du personnel a été tué et deux élèves ont été blessés après qu'un élève a ouvert le feu. Le tireur présumé a également été tué. Les élèves de l'école intermédiaire ont été évacués et rassemblés pour retrouver leurs parents à l'école élémentaire.

resultats_lens.texte_contexte: Un incendie massif s'est déclaré dans un centre de fabrication General Electric (GE) au Kentucky. Plus de 120 pompiers de Louisville ont combattu les flammes dans le bâtiment six du complexe General Electric Appliance Park à Louisville, dans le Kentucky, le vendredi 3 avril 2015. L'incendie a débuté dans un bâtiment sans production, créant d'immenses colonnes de fumée. Selon la porte-parole de GE, Kim Freeman, aucun blessé n'a été signalé.

[CAPTIONING SPONSORED BY SLEEP TRAIN MATTRESS CENTERS, YOUR TICKET TO A BETTER NIGHT'S SLEEP!] TWO DEAD, TWO INJURED, AFTER SHOOTING AT SPARKS MIDDLE SCHOOL IN NEVADA. SHOTS WERE FIRED BEFORE CLASSES STARTED THIS MORNING. WE ARE LEARNING NEW INFORMATION ABOUT WHO POLICE SAY FIRED THOSE SHOTS. DAVID BIENICK JOINS US LIVE ON THE PHONE FROM RENO, NEVADA, WITH THE LATEST ON THE SITUATION. WE ARE OUTSIDE THE MEDICAL CENTER IN RENO. THIS IS WHERE TWO STUDENTS, BOTH BOYS, HAVE BEEN BROUGHT, FOLLOWING THE SHOOTING THIS MORNING AT SPARKS MIDDLE SCHOOL, ABOUT TWO MILES AWAY FROM HERE. THEY WERE BOTH BROUGHT HERE IN CRITICAL CONDITION. WE DON'T HAVE AN UPDATED CONDITION REPORT ON THEM YET BUT WE DO KNOW THAT ONE OF THE BOYS IS NOW OUT OF SURGERY. IT STARTED AROUND A QUARTER AFTER SEVEN THIS MORNING, JUST AS STUDENTS WERE ARRIVING AT SPARKS MIDDLE SCHOOL. POLICE SAY A BOY WITH A GUN AND OPENED FIRE. A STAFF MEMBER, A TEACHER DIED FROM HIS INJURIES, AND POLICE ARE NOW DESCRIBING WHAT THAT TEACHER DID AS THE ACTIVE A HERO. -- AS THE ACT OF A HERO. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE THERE IS ANYONE INVOLVED OTHER THAN THE INDIVIDUAL. WHEN THE OFFICERS GOT ON SCENE, THE SCHOOL IS ON LOCKDOWN. A SWAT TEAM WHEN IN AND CLOSE THE ENTIRE SCHOOL. WE HAD BOMB DOGS COME THROUGH JUST AS OF ARE CAUTIONED TO CHECK THE OUTSIDE AND ALL THAT HAS SHOWN THAT AT THIS TIME THERE IS NO ONE ELSE INVOLVED. OUR HEARTS GO OUT TO ALL THOSE THAT HAVE BEEN AFFECTED, THE STUDENTS, FAMILIES, ALL THOSE PEOPLE INVOLVED. I WANT TO REITERATE AGAIN THAT THE CITY ITSELF IS VERY SAFE. ON BEHALF OF MY FELLOW BOARD MEMBERS, I WANT TO SAY HOW TRAGIC THIS IS AND HOW SADDENED WE ARE. OUR STUDENT SAFETY AND STAFF SAFETY IS OF UTMOST, PARAMOUNT CONCERN TO US, AND WE ARE DOING EVERYTHING THAT WE POSSIBLY CAN TO ASSIST THE POLICE AS WELL AS OUR PARENTS, OUR STUDENTS, AND STAFF, BY PROVIDING INTERVENTION AND COUNSELING, AND WE WILL BE HERE AND DO WHATEVER IS NECESSARY TO ENSURE THAT EVERYONE HAS AN OPPORTUNITY TO HAVE THEIR NEEDS MET. POLICE HAVE NOT IDENTIFIED THE STUDENT WHO THEY SAY WAS THE SHOOTER IN THIS CASE, NOR HAD THEY IDENTIFIED THE STAFF MEMBER WHO DIED IN THIS SHOOTING. THE POLICE DID SAY, AND THIS IS A VERY INSTINCT POINT, THAT DURING THIS INCIDENT, THEY FIRED NO SHOTS. THERE WERE NO LAW-ENFORCEMENT SHOTS FIRED, SO WE ARE UNCLEAR HOW THE STUDENT SUSPECT I, PERHAPS BY TAKING HIS OWN LIFE. WE EXPECT AN UPDATE ON THAT SITUATION AND MORE DETAILS ON HOW THE TEACHER SERVED AS A HERO IN THIS CASE WHEN THE POLICE HERE IN RENO GIVE US ANOTHER UPDATE AT 4:00 THIS AFTERNOON. DAVID BIENICK, KCRA 3 NEWS. SUCH A SCARY AND TRAGIC SITUATION. TWO ARE DEAD, ONE INCLUDES THE SHOOTER. THE OTHER IS A TEACHER, AND THE TWO THAT WERE INJURED WERE STUDENTS THERE, CORRECT ?

resultats_lens.texte_contexte: Deux personnes ont été tuées et deux autres blessées lors d'une fusillade lundi matin à l'école intermédiaire de Sparks, dans le Nevada. Les coups de feu ont retenti avant le début des cours. Deux garçons ont été transportés en état critique au centre médical de Reno, distant d'environ deux miles. Un membre du personnel (un enseignant) a perdu la vie après avoir agi héroïquement. La police et un équipe du SWAT sont intervenues sur les lieux qui ont été bouclés, et aucun autre suspect n'a été impliqué. La police n'a pas tiré de coups de feu lors de l'incident.
